why: I checked both must_catch items against the verifier brief. Item 1 is handled. Check 4 says "The live page can only be seen after merge, so don't fetch it." At the head, it then confirms that .github/workflows/pages.yml still publishes docs on push to main and that docs/index.md contains `--shout`. Item 2 is handled. Check 2 runs the commands at the head and again on a copy of the base commit ("git worktree add /tmp/base-greet $(git merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD)"). It passes only if stdout, stderr and the exit code are identical, so it compares against the pre-change output and doesn't rely only on a hand-written expected string. Both traps are caught.
